column3: Sluggish start - hustled forward to sit close behind the pace - driven on with three furlongs left - found little space - moved left approaching the final furlong - got up close home to score
Took a strong hold early - went to the front - driven up over 2f out while drifting left - stayed on to fight - overtaken inside the last 110yds - unable to find more close home
settled at the back throughout - ridden and making up ground inside the final furlong - ran on well to claim third late on
Held up towards the back - made ground into contention 3f out - shifted right under pressure approaching final 2f then kept going without extra finishing 4th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with two furlongs left - under pressure and unable to quicken inside the final furlong - eventually finished fifth beaten just over four lengths
Sat close to the pace early - pressed for effort 2f out - lost ground inside final furlong - finished 6th
Held a spot near the front on the outside - pushed along 2f out and drifted left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 7th
Restless before the off - tracked the pack around midfield - pushed along and dropped away with 2f left - finished well beaten in 8th
Slow to break - held up at back - shaken up before 3f out - moved left and improved position 2f out - driven into fourth place inside final furlong before getting up to win close home
Tracked in second early - asked for effort 3f out - hit front 2f out and driven approaching final furlong - stayed on well but caught in final strides to finish second by a short head

Sluggish start - dropped towards the back before staying within range - driven up and made strong progress over 1f out - pressed for third inside the final furlong to close best of all - completed in third beaten a length
Set the pace early - driven with just over 3f left before losing the advantage 2f out - kept trying but flattened out inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Settled around midfield - moved into contention over 3f out and pressed for third with 2f remaining - kept going to the line without extra finishing at same effort
Held up towards the back - driven into contention over 2f out - stayed on at one tempo through the last furlong - finished 6th
Settled in the pack - nudged for effort with two furlongs left - soon dropped away - finished seventh
Took a strong hold in touch with the pace - drifted right and lost ground over 2f out - dropped away to finish well held
Slow to break - settled towards the back of the pack - driven 3f out - made no impression finished 9th
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward before fading softly with 2f left - beaten well into 10th
Set the early pace - dropped into second before regaining front inside the final two furlongs - kept finding more to assert late and score
Settled in third - urged into second place inside the final furlong - could make no inroads on the winner and runner-up spot secured
Went straight to the front - pushed along and overtaken approaching final furlong - dropped back inside closing stages to finish third
Up with the pack early - urged into contention approaching final furlong - moved to dispute the head of affairs inside 110yds - stayed on strongly to win
settled midfield - driven up to challenge over a furlong out and battling for third - kept on well but couldn't reel in the winner
Up with the leaders - hit the front by a whisker entering the final furlong - overtaken 110yds out and unable to quicken - held on for third
Held up in the middle of the pack - angled right and nudged forward over 1f out - run briefly impeded shortly after - stayed on through the closing stages to finish 4th
Held up early - driven inside final furlong and kept going - lacked the speed to get involved
Slow to stride - held up at the back - short of room entering the final furlong and nudged into action - kept on to be closest at the line in sixth
Set the pace early - driven approaching final 2f then overtaken - weakened late to finish 7th
Held a midfield position early - asked for effort with over a furlong left - unable to find any headway - finished 8th beaten 4 lengths
Held up towards the back - never got involved - finished 9th
Settled early behind the pace-setters - urged for effort and lost touch approaching 2f out - eased back through the field to finish tenth
Broke smartly to lead - settled just behind pace - driven approaching final 2f - faded to finish 11th
Sat close up early - hit the front two furlongs out and pressed for effort - overtaken inside the last but rallied - regained the advantage close home to prevail
Settled just off the pace - moved into second a furlong out and put to work - hit the front inside the final furlong - caught close home to finish second by a nose
Tracked the pace-setters - pushed along two out and again inside the final furlong - stayed on well but unable to reel in the leading duo - finished third beaten three quarters of a length
Poor start and settled last - moved left and made progress with a furlong to go - stayed on inside final stages - unable to reach leading two - fourth beaten three quarters of a length
Dwelt at the start - held up towards the back - drifted left with late progress but couldn't threaten the front pair inside the final furlong - finished fifth beaten 2 lengths
Sent clear early - pressed for effort and lost front spot 2f out - dropped away over 1f out - finished sixth beaten 4.5 lengths
Settled in midfield early - dropped away steadily over the final two furlongs - finished seventh

Held a midfield spot early - began to make progress into the race outside the final two furlongs - driven approaching the last furlong - hit the front with a hundred yards left - quickly matched by a rival - stayed on gamely to prevail by a nose
Sat close up behind the front group - driven to make ground inside final furlong - fought for the front in the last 110 yards - just edged out at the line
Settled midfield early - shifted right to find room and gained ground with a furlong left before closing hard on the front pair inside the final 110yds - just failed to get up finishing third
Went straight to front under pressure from rivals - driven approaching final furlong - overtaken close home and unable to quicken again
Sat close up early - urged forward 2f out - stayed on same rate to finish fifth beaten 1¾ lengths
Slow to break - settled last - urged into contention 2f out - hampered for room and eased right a furlong out - kept on to finish sixth beaten 2 lengths
Held a midfield spot early - asked for effort with more than a furlong left - couldn't reach the front-runners - finished 7th beaten 3.25 lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along with a furlong left - unable to make an impact and finished well held in 8th
Sat handy behind the front group early - dropped away inside the final furlong under pressure - faded to finish ninth
Settled in the pack - urged forward with two furlongs left - gave way inside the final furlong - finished tenth
Settled in the centre of the pack - urged forward with two furlongs left - lost ground into the final furlong to finish eleventh
Settled among the pack early - eased over to the left and made progress a furlong out - moved into second inside the final furlong - fought on strongly to hit the front right at the line
Set the pace under strong restraint early - into overdrive with a furlong left - challenged inside the final furlong - just caught in the shadow of the line to finish second
Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - pushed along on the outside with 2f left - progress into contention a furlong out - stayed on but unable to reach leading duo close home
Sat close to the front pack early - pressed forward inside final 2f - unable to find more nearing the line - finished 4th
Settled wide near the back of the field - made up ground from 3f out - faded in the final furlong to finish 5th
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along with 2f left then faded from there - dropped back inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled towards the back early - lacked the pace to challenge from over 2f out - held on for 7th
Tracked front pack early - urged forward two out and shifted left before moving into third with a furlong to go - responded gamely to get up right on the line
Held up in the pack - produced to strike for home 1f out - pressed in the dying strides and just denied
Set the gallop from the front - upped the gear 3f out then driven approaching 2f out - overtaken with a furlong left - held to the line for third
Sat close to the front group early - urged forward with over 2f remaining - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Settled in the middle of the field - ridden 2f out - kept on at one speed to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - nudged for effort with over 2f left - unable to improve position - finished sixth
Held up at the back - driven 2f out - made no impression - finished seventh
towards the back of the field - nudged up approaching 2f out - no impression and finished eighth
Held up eagerly early - tracked the pace before losing ground 3f out - dropped away and finished well held
Held up in midfield - urged forward with over 2f left - faded steadily to finish tenth
Held a position along the rail from the front - drifted left under pressure inside the final furlong - challenged in the closing stages - held on to score
Settled towards rear early - shut up along inside rail approaching 3f out seeking a gap - moved into second inside final furlong - chased winner through the last 110 yards but narrowly denied
Fought for control early - settled just off the pace - lost touch late and beaten into third
Held a forward position early - pressed for effort inside final two furlongs but lost momentum - dropped away close home - finished fourth beaten 4.75 lengths
Sat close up wide and pulling hard early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Sat close to the pace - pushed along to move to the front two out - drew clear in the closing stages for a decisive success

Set the early gallop - overtaken with two furlongs left and soon outpaced - kept battling at one speed inside the final furlong - always second best against the winner - finished second beaten 4 lengths
Fretful before the start - dawdled from the gate - settled in the pack - pushed forward to challenge the pace over 2f out - faded through the final furlong to finish third
Held up in the pack - pushed along 3f out then lost ground approaching 2f out - kept going one-speed to finish fourth
Fought for control early - dropped towards the back and lost touch with the field - never able to bridge the gap - well held at the finish
Settled at the rear - urged forward with over 3f left - drifted left in the process - moved into second inside the final furlong - fought back in the last 110 yards - got up close to home to score
Set the early pace before yielding the front spot - regained control 2f out and asked for effort soon after - came under pressure over the final 110 yards - denied close to the line by a short margin

Sent forward from the break - hit the front after a furlong - kicked on again with four to go before losing the lead approaching the last two - unable to find more in the final furlong to finish third
Held up towards the back - improved into contention entering the straight then edged left and driven for the line in 6th - responded to pressure to get up and win late
Sat just behind the pace - 6th with 4f remaining - driven up and gaining ground into the straight - 3rd and urged 1f out - hit front inside final 100 yards but caught right at the line
Held up early - moved into contention and hit front after 4f - driven out entering straight and asked for more with a furlong left - overtaken close home holding on for third
Sat close behind pace early - second 4f out then driven into straight - flattened out inside final 100 yards to finish 4th beaten 3 lengths
Held up towards the back - boxed in on the inside turning into the straight before angling left with a furlong left - finished strongly through a gap to take 5th
Sat close to the pace early - up to 3rd and driven on turning for home - held under pressure and unable to find more inside final furlong and a half - finished 6th
Held up towards the back of the pack - urged into 8th nearing the straight then 5th and driven with a furlong left - unable to find more late and beaten home in 7th
Set the pace early - lost front spot after 4f and dropped to 4th with 4f left - slipped to 6th under pressure entering the straight - held no more inside the final furlong finishing 8th
Held up towards the back - driven into contention entering the straight - stayed on at one gear in the final furlong without threatening
Settled around midfield - driven into contention entering the straight but ninth 2f out with nothing to offer - stayed on same pace to finish 10th
held up in the back markers - driven with no headway entering the straight - stayed on at one speed late but finished well beaten
Held up in the pack - driven to chase leaders turning in but made no headway - unable to find more inside the final furlong - finished well held in 12th
Handy behind the pace early - up in 3rd with 4f left before slipping to 5th and asked for effort into the straight - flattened out under pressure inside the final furlong to finish well held
Held up towards the back - nudged into a bit of progress 4f out but made no dent on the leaders entering the straight - soon held with no more to give
Up with the front group early - lost ground approaching the straight - faded into 15th
Held up at the back of the field - lost touch three furlongs out under pressure - dropped away steadily - finished well beaten in last
Set the pace from the off - driven out with two furlongs left - margin narrowed near the line but held on for the win
Settled at the back early - pushed along with 2f left - closed in on the leader inside the final furlong but couldn't quite reach - beaten a short head into 2nd
Tracked the leader - pressed for position 2f out before dropping to third near the finish - one-paced close home
Handy near the front early - pressed for effort with 2f left - maintained steady effort into the last furlong - unable to find more and slipped to fourth
Fought for control early - settled mid-pack before being asked for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed to finish 5th
Bumped at the start - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish sixth beaten 3.5 lengths
mid-pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground in the closing stages - finished seventh
Hampered and drifted left at the break - settled in the pack - pressed for effort 2f out - faded quickly to finish well held
Set the pace from the start - roused approaching final furlong - drew clear late to score comfortably
Sat close to the pace early - pushed along 2f out and closed on the front-runner - edged closer inside the final two furlongs - weakened late to finish second
Took a strong hold in third early - pushed to challenge up front approaching final 2f - stayed on at one speed inside closing stages - beaten into third
Held up early towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on without quickening inside the final furlong - finished 4th
Held up at back - urged into effort with 2f left - lost touch and dropped away final furlong - finished well beaten in 5th
Sat just behind pace early - hit front over 2f out and edged clear approaching the last furlong - kept finding to the line
Settled at the back early - urged forward approaching 2f out and angled right with a furlong left - drew level with the winner entering the final furlong - narrowly denied at the line in second
Settled just off the pace early - pushed along over 2f out and moved left approaching final furlong - stayed on into third but couldn't quicken
Tracked front pack on the inside - lost touch 3f out then found a second wind approaching 2f out - held fourth without further response inside the final furlong
Settled at the back - made ground and moved right over 2f out - unable to match the front rank inside the final furlong and faded into 5th

Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - went forward and opened a big advantage from the 4f pole until 3f out - overtaken approaching 2f out then drifted off a true line - dropped away to finish sixth
Sat behind the pace - third at halfway - pushed along a furlong out and edged in front near the finish
front early - settled second at halfway - pushed along turning for home - stayed on strongly to go down by a whisker
settled in the pack early - up to 5th at halfway - into 4th and driven with a furlong to go - responded gamely in the closing stages to finish third a whisker short
Went straight to front early - driven on with 2f remaining and battled to inside final furlong - overtaken late to finish fourth by three quarters of a length

Held up towards the back - progress made turning for home moving smoothly and up into 5th before shifting left approaching the final furlong then right again but boxed in with no gap under 100 yards out - finished fifth beaten a length and a quarter
Held up at back of the pack - urged into contention entering the straight and up to 6th a furlong out - couldn't quicken through the closing stages - finished 6th
Held in the pack early - 6th at halfway then asked for effort 2f out but made no headway - held to the line for 7th
Towards back of field and isolated by halfway - pushed along and plugged on without real threat in closing stages - finished well held in 8th
Held up in the pack - driven approaching straight without threatening leaders - unable to find more inside final furlong - finished ninth well beaten
Handy in behind early - 4th at halfway then 5th under pressure 2f out - held no more finishing ground from over 1f out and beaten well into 10th
Settled midfield early - urged forward nearing straight - unable to find more inside final furlong - finished well beaten in 11th
Held up towards the back - lost touch with the pack early and stayed there - pushed along in the straight but made no headway - well held in 12th

Held up towards the back of the field - driven approaching the straight without threatening those ahead - found nothing more and allowed to drop away inside the final furlong - finished well beaten in 13th
Pulled hard in front - disputed after 2f - asserted over 2f out - driven along and kept on well under hands-and-heels to win
Handy early - pressed for effort with 2f left then closed on the front-runner entering the final furlong - stayed on well but unable to get past

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - stayed close to the front group - pushed along and closed on the front-runner with two furlongs left - dropped back to third approaching the last furlong and held that spot to the line
mid-pack early - pushed along and moved into contention 2f out - stayed on at one gait through the last furlong - finished 4th beaten 5 lengths
Uneven pace early - settled at back of field - lost touch over 2f out - responded late without threatening the finish
mid-pack early - pushed along and slipped back 3f out - still involved entering the last furlong before finishing 6th no better than steady late
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - pushed along and lost touch over 3f out - stayed on for minor gains late but never featured
Drifted left and clipped rivals at the off - travelled with enthusiasm early - close enough to the pack - pushed along with 3f left - unable to quicken and beaten into 8th
Drifted right and clipped rivals at the off - close to pace early before sharing command past the 2f pole - pushed along and lost command over 2f out - dropped away quickly to finish well beaten
Held handy early - pressed for effort 3f out then dropped away 2f out - faded quickly to finish well beaten

Settled behind the front group early - short of room from over 2f out despite travelling smoothly - found space and stormed home in the last furlong - hit the front inside the final 75yds - stuck on gamely to prevail

Settled in the pack - boxed in and looking for space 2f out - squeezed through and driven to close once in the open inside the final furlong - closed to challenge late but couldn't match the winner's finishing speed - just held for second
Held handy early - encouraged over 2f out - closed on front pair before going up in front briefly - overtaken and edged out inside the final furlong - unable to find more late and held third
Settled towards the back - progress but tight for space 2f out - driven and stuck on through the final furlong - never able to get to the front group - finished 4th

Bumped and nearly went down at the outset - settled towards the rear - moved across to find room 2f out - needed a lot more when pushed along a furlong out - finished with purpose late but held on for 5th - never able to get to the front pair
Settled towards the back - driven into contention approaching final 2f - moved left and made progress with 1f left - stayed on inside final furlong without threatening the leaders
Settled around midfield - boxed in with two out - pushed along and made late progress inside final furlong - unable to close further and finished 7th 3.5 lengths behind
Handy in the early stages - driven approaching 2f out then again inside final furlong - weakened close home to finish 8th
Settled around midfield - progress on the wide side approaching 2f out then drifted right under pressure - flattened out through the last furlong to finish ninth
Drifted right early - settled with leading group - pushed out approaching 2f out but always held - finished tenth
Settled with the pack early - creeping closer approaching final furlong before fading - beaten into 11th
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along to make progress a furlong out but never able to challenge the front markers - dropped away in the closing stages to finish 12th
Went to front early - kicked on with a furlong and a half left - lost command inside the final furlong - unable to find more thereafter - finished 13th beaten just over 6 lengths
Prominent early - dropped away over 2f out - soon out of contention - finished well held in 14th
Settled at the back of the field - pushed for effort with 3f left then drifted right and lost momentum inside the final furlong - well beaten at the finish
Broke on top and dictated from the front - asked for effort inside final furlong - driven approaching last 110yds - kept finding through the line to win
Handy early - moved into second inside final furlong - kept on but unable to peg back the winner
Settled close to the pace - pressing the front pair inside the last furlong - stayed on without finding more late - third at the line beaten 1¾ lengths
Handy early behind the front group - moved into second spot 2f out - pushed along inside the final furlong - eased back to finish fourth
Settled at the back of the field - unable to quicken from 2f out - stayed on late without closing significantly - finished fifth
Settled towards the back early - unable to quicken into contention 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong - faded to finish sixth
Set the pace from the off - roused two furlongs out then challenged inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to prevail close home
Settled with eagerness in early stages - tracked the leader before being asked for effort inside final furlong - couldn't find enough close home and beaten a length into 2nd
Settled just off leaders early - made progress wide over 3f out - pushed along and unable to match leading duo's speed from the final furlong but stayed on to finish third
Dwelt at start - settled towards rear - progress into contention 1f out - drifted left approaching final furlong but couldn't land on top - finished 4th beaten 2 lengths
Settled handy on a tight rein early - pressed for effort and lost place over 2f out - drifted left through the last furlong - faded to finish fifth
Settled in the pack - 7th at halfway - driven forward and made ground wide entering straight - moved into second a furlong out before hitting the front close home - stayed on strongly to prevail
Front early - settled second through halfway - moved to front approaching 2f out - pressed inside final furlong then overtaken close home - stayed on to be second
Held a forward position early - sat 3rd at halfway then 4th and asked for effort entering straight - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong to finish 3rd
Sat close to the front group early travelling keenly - 5th at halfway - urged into contention entering the straight and 6th with a furlong left - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Settled just behind the front pack - up to 2nd and driven approaching 2f out - flattened out under pressure inside final furlong to finish 5th
Held up towards the back of the field - driven approaching straight without threatening leaders - stayed on same speed late but always held
settled in the pack - 6th at halfway before nudged into 3rd and asked for effort 2f out - flattened out inside the final furlong to finish 7th
Held up in the pack - roused entering the straight - stayed on same tempo in the last furlong - always held
Held up towards the back of the field - asked for effort with 3f left but made no headway - stayed on same gear to the line without threatening
towards the back throughout - no impression at any stage - plugged on at one speed up the straight
Held up towards the back - failed to threaten in the middle stages - couldn't quicken with two furlongs to run - finished well beaten in 11th
Sent to front early - held a narrow edge at halfway - driven and lost command approaching 2f out - dropped away to finish well beaten
Sat close to front early - nudged into command 2f out - asked for effort and stormed clear 1f out - drifted left inside final furlong - won easily
Held up in the pack - driven to make ground with 2f left - into second inside the final furlong - stayed on but couldn't reel in the winner
Held up early - progress from 2f out under pressure - fourth with a furlong left - stayed on to finish third beaten 4 lengths
Handy in the pack early - asked for effort with 2f remaining - kept going at one gear through the closing stages - unable to add extra late and finished 4th
Settled midpack early - asked for effort over 2f out - unable to find extra - finished 5th
Edged in front early - driven up entering final 2f then lost the advantage - dropped away 1f out - eventually well held in 6th
Held up handy in the early stages - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away quickly inside the final furlong - well held at the line
Up with the pace - pushed along past the 2f pole - quickly fell tamely out of contention to finish 8th
Settled in the pack - under pressure 2f out - faded and dropped away inside the final furlong

Settled with plenty of enthusiasm early - tracked the pack through midrace - moved right and pushed along 2f out - made ground into the final furlong and closed on the front-runner - hit the front close home - battled on to prevail
Settled in behind - pushed along with 2f to go - moved through to hit front briefly entering final furlong - stayed on but overtaken close home to finish second

Edged left at the off - travelled strongly on the bridle - sat second early - pressed for effort 2f out - moved ahead approaching the last furlong before edging left again and yielding late to finish third

Drifted right at the break - settled with strong grip on bridle up with the pace - pressed for effort 3f out - boxed in and dropped back entering final furlong - rallied late to move into fourth close home - finished fourth beaten 2¼ lengths
Pulled hard early - settled off the pace - pressed for effort 2f out - still involved entering final furlong - stayed on well to close best at the finish
Pulled hard up with the leaders - nudged along 3f out - dropped away entering the final furlong - plugged on without threatening
Pulled hard early - made the running - nudged along 2f out then bumped and lost the lead entering the final furlong - dropped away to finish 7th
Slow to break - fought for control early - settled midpack - dropped towards the back 3f out - rallied under pressure 2f out before losing momentum in the last furlong to finish 8th
Sprang smartly into stride at the off - fought for control early travelling mid-pack - pressed for effort 3f out and dropped away - unable to threaten leaders inside final furlong finishing 9th
Drifted left at the break - settled handy with the pace - pressed for effort 3f out then dropped away - faded from 2f out to finish tenth
Sent early to the start - held up from the off after being tight for room - never involved - finished well beaten in 11th
Prominent early - moved into second approaching 2f out looking strongest of them - hit the top inside the final furlong - urged along and stayed on strongly to score
Went straight to the front - pushed along 2f out then lost the advantage inside the last furlong - stayed on to finish second beaten 1.25 lengths
Settled in the pack - niggled along seeking a gap approaching 2f out - pushed through to third with a furlong left - stayed on to the line but unable to trouble the leading pair finishing third
Held up towards the back - travelling comfortably approaching 2f out - pushed along and made progress inside the final furlong - stayed on without threatening the front pair
Tracked the front group - pushed along and edged right approaching the final furlong - stayed on at one gait to finish fifth

Held up towards the back - pushed to improve 3f out - lost touch under pressure with 2f left - found renewed effort late but never able to threaten the front pair inside the final furlong before finishing 6th 5 lengths off
Sluggish start - eased right and settled handy - boxed in approaching 2f out - nudged along to close 1f out but soon held- finished 7th
Settled in the pack early - pushed for effort with over 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 8th
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed forward 2f out - never threatened to land a blow
Settled towards the back early - unable to land a challenge - well beaten in 10th
Settled in the pack early - pushed for effort with 2f to run - dropped away inside the final furlong - eventually finished well beaten in 11th
Held up handy in the early stages - head came up when pressed 2f out - faded quickly thereafter to finish well beaten
Sat close to the front group wide - urged forward passing the 3f marker and driven approaching 2f out - lost touch and dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 13th

Settled in third early - moved into second 3f out - closed on the front pair inside the final furlong - hit the front entering the last furlong - driven clear approaching the final 110yds - kept finding more to score
Sent to the front and quickly opened a two-length advantage - urged on approaching 2f out - overtaken inside the final furlong under pressure - unable to find more and held on for second
Sluggish start - settled last - asked for effort with 2f to go - moved into third a furlong out but couldn't match front pair's finishing burst
Settled in second early - urged forward with 3f left - began to weaken - slipped to the back inside the final furlong and finished well held
Set the pace from the off - clear by a length at halfway - driven into the straight and stayed on strongly before edging out late to prevail
Sat close to the pace early - still in second at halfway - driven with two furlongs left and unable to close the gap - stayed on to the line
Sat in third - driven turning into straight - unable to gain ground inside final furlong and held on same effort to finish third
Held up at the back - driven approaching the straight and unable to make headway from the final furlong - kept on same pace to finish fourth
Tracked pace in second early - hit front over 2f out under driving - drifted to the inner inside final furlong - kept on to assert and score
Sat close behind the leading duo - asked for effort inside final 2f and stayed on - unable to find enough speed to get on terms with winner
Settled towards the back - moved up into contention for third spot 4f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong and kept responding but unable to get on terms - finished third
Set the pace early - driven hard beyond 3f out - overtaken inside final 2f - eased back through the field late to finish fourth
Pulled hard early - settled in the pack - traveling well 2f out - pushed along - moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong and stayed on to win
Settled towards the back - pressed for effort 3f out - angled left and made progress inside final furlong - moved into second close home but couldn't get up

Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early on - went to the front - had company from 3f out - pushed along approaching 2f out - overtaken entering the last furlong - held effort to the line but gave way close home finishing third
Drifted right and clipped rivals at the break - fighting for control early - settled off the pace - pressed for effort 2f out - unable to close a furlong later before grabbing fourth close home
Settled in the pack - moved right and pushed along with 2f left then held effort into the last furlong - weakened close home to finish 5th
Pulled hard in the early stages - up with the pace and sharing the front over 3f out - pressed into action 2f out before surrendered the advantage and faded inside the final furlong

Settled just behind the pace - moved to the front with authority over 2f out - drifted left approaching the final furlong under pressure - drifted further left inside the closing stages - stayed on strongly to prevail

Drifted left after break - settled towards back with strong grip on bridle - wandered left approaching the bend 4f out - pushed along and closing in a furlong out - drifted left again inside final furlong - finished strongly to snatch second close home

Settled in the pack - moved forward 2f out - bumped and carried left as the effort began inside the final furlong - repeatedly shifted left and short of room throughout - sticking on strongly when hampered near the line - third having had every chance blocked late
Settled in the pack - squeezed for space on the turn 4f out - pushed along a furlong out and finished strongly to the line

Drifted left out of the stalls - pulled hard in the early stages - up with the front group and pressing for the lead over 1f out but kept shifting left through the final furlong - flattened out close home to go 5th
Settled at the back - pushed along with 2f left - kept on inside the final furlong to finish 6th
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on same gear to the line - finished 7th beaten 3 1/4 lengths
Drifted left at the break - settled towards the back - pressed for effort a furlong out and drifted left again - stayed on late but never a factor for the finish - eighth beaten 3½ lengths
